news.text: At Innovate4Cities in Nairobi, the conference of UN-Habitat and the Global Covenant of Mayors, I presented MUV and the GenAI game engine we are building to personalise climate challenges for each citizen

Launch of BE CIRCULAR, supported by Fondazione con il Sud: three social tailoring workshops turning textile waste into new work. At the University of Palermo we will help students design products and services from it

Four weeks in Tamale, Northern Ghana, with the University for Development Studies, studying how design can make climate information reach smallholder farmers (ClearClimate, Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions)
